notes:
Sort menu of the use-case list (CHR-1097), opened from the sort control in the result line (`uc-sort`, `aria-haspopup="menu"`, `aria-expanded="true"` while open). Same list as `usecases-list`, with the Status filter applied ("Status: Ready") and its menu closed.

**Options, in this order:** Group A–Z (default; tree grouped by `group` path) · Title · Status. One is checked (`chrome-menu-item` `checked`); there is no title row, no divider and no clear item. There is no "Recently changed" sort (Christian, 2026-11-16): the case files carry no timestamp that `list_use_cases` reports.

**Behaviour (as built, same menu as the filter chips).** A manual popover in the top layer, placed 4px below the control and left-aligned with it. Up/Down move, Home/End jump, Enter or click picks and reloads the list from the first page, Esc or a click outside closes and returns focus to the control. Title and Status show a flat list without group headers; Group A–Z shows the tree.

**Flows.** Any option → `usecases-list`.
